description: A real SOLD train post (source_id 1340570821111078915) with zero word-bank-eligible words — all its content is pronouns/verb-forms/particles the candidate filter excludes. Coverage jumped to 94% under v2 (up from v1's 21.8%), so the OLD zero-match regression text ('මට කිසි දෙයක් අවශ්‍ය නෑ') no longer qualifies — 'දෙයක්' and 'අවශ්‍ය' both got translated into the new word bank. This proves selection never invents a substitution where nothing is genuinely eligible, even at heavy severity, even though that's now the ~6% minority case rather than the ~80%+ majority case v1 left untouched.
